I'll start by inspecting the changed files and verifying the claims.# Audit report — SVG escaping in `bench/report.py`

## What I inspected
- `git diff HEAD -- bench/report.py`, `bench/README.md`; read the new `bench/test_report_svg.py` (227 lines).
- Ran the suite, `py_compile`, reproduced a hostile `--label` end-to-end, parsed every emitted SVG with `xml.etree.ElementTree`, ran old (`git show HEAD:bench/report.py`) vs new over two real results folders, diffed `--help`, checked `git status --porcelain bench/results`.

## Findings
The core work is genuinely correct and complete on its own terms:
- `esc()` (report.py:62-68) filters non-`Char` codepoints to U+FFFD then `html.escape(quote=True)` — exactly once, at insertion; independently reproduced (`'\x01' -> '�'`, `'a & b <c> "d" \'e\'' -> 'a & b <c> "d" 'e''`).
- Every dynamic insertion in `chart()` and `hero()` is wrapped (report.py:134,139-140,144,154,162,168,191,198-199,216,222-223,228,235,238); `text_width` still measures raw text.
- Injection reproduction: label `"></text><script>alert(1)</script><text x="0" y="0">&` is written as `"></text><script>...`; `grep -c '<script'` = 0 in a sample of the emitted charts, and all 12 SVGs parse with root `{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg` and attributes exactly `['aria-label','height','role','viewBox','width']`.
- Regression value is real: the same suite run against `git show HEAD:bench/report.py` fails `FAILED (failures=3, errors=6)` (an unescaped `<script>` in old output).
- Byte-identical appearance: old-vs-new over `2026-10-10-windows-0.8.0` (12 SVGs) and `2026-10-12-linux-x64-0.8.5` (10 SVGs) gives `svg_diff=0`, `md_diff=0`; `bench/results` stays clean.
- README requirement 10 is met, including the documented Markdown limitation.

The one blocking gap: contract gate 6 is **contradicted**, not merely unproven. The executor added a four-line paragraph to the module docstring (report.py:18-21), and `argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)` (report.py:292) turns it into extra `--help` text. My diff of `--help` against the pre-change script shows that paragraph added:

```
18a19,22
> 
> Everything a chart draws that does not come from the code - labels, build ids, plugin and step names, versions, figures and notes -
> goes into the SVG through esc(): XML's five special characters are escaped once, at the insertion point, and characters XML
> forbids become U+FFFD, so a label cannot add an element or an attribute to the document and every chart parses as XML.
```

The executor's own summary concedes this ("`--help` output gained the documentation paragraph") and reframes the gate as "flags and usage lines identical". Requirement 10 asks for `bench/README.md` only; the docstring paragraph is not needed by the objective, so the acceptance check should be restored rather than redefined.

## Outside Scope
- `--help`'s `usage:` line also differs only because the old copy is named `old_report.py`; that part is incidental to any diff against a `git show` copy and not a defect.

- `git status` shows only the three reviewed paths plus the pre-existing untracked `.pi-glla/`; `bench/results` clean.
